name: Zoo Teen Program at Potter Park Zoo
org: Potter Park Zoo (Potter Park Zoological Society and Ingham County)
what_you_do: You teach guests at conservation stations. You work with the goat contact yard. You help in the Zookambi summer camp. You learn about zoo careers from zookeepers.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 13 to 17 who can work independently, have reliable transportation to the zoo, and can work outside in all weather.
pay_detail: $50 program fee (shirt, training materials, name tag), paid at orientation, not at application. Scholarships are available.
duration: At least 40 hours of service from June to August
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. Information session dates and May 2027 orientation dates will be posted in January 2027. You must attend an information session to get the application.
how_to_apply: Step 1: attend an information session. Step 2: complete the application you receive afterward. Step 3: attend orientation and the required training. Keep a journal and finish monthly prompts.
notes: The zoo's volunteer page says teens 13 to 18 use this separate program; the program page itself says 13 to 17, so confirm the upper age. The regular adult volunteer program is 18 and older. Returning teens (years 3 to 5, under 18) can apply for the Zoo Teen Leadership Council. Contact is on the program page. Michigan's youth employment page (Youth Employment Standards Act) says the law covers employers of anyone under 18 including volunteers, so ask the program whether a work permit is needed.
